title: v0.6.1
body:
The markdown work of October 2026, released together because every piece changes how a body, a note or a memory looks and the prime text describes them as one set.

- headings of one to three `#` and a `---` rule in the parser
- `show`, `recall` and `memories` rendering markdown on a terminal
- the new look: inline code in cyan, a gutter on code blocks, a bold table header

Nothing breaks: the data on `refs/foam/data`, the piped output, `--plain` and `--json` are as they were. So the number is a patch.
